Project a GEO series' samples onto PC1 x PC2, as GeneFox's sample PCA screen does (top 2,000 most variable...

gf_geo_sample_pca.Rd

Project a GEO series' samples onto PC1 x PC2, as GeneFox's sample PCA screen does (top 2,000 most variable rows by default, or top_genes; optional log2(x+1), gene scaling), optionally colored by a sample characteristic or by one gene's expression, with sample exclusions; optionally the scree series, the genes most correlated with each PC and their loadings, and the biplot. Returns variance explained, per-sample scores, the scatter and requested section figures and optionally their CSVs. Latency: the matrix download when cold, then seconds. The figure is the app's GEO › Sample PCA PNG export.

Usage

gf_geo_sample_pca(
    session,
    `accession`,
    `biplot` = NULL,
    `color_by` = NULL,
    `color_gene` = NULL,
    `color_probe` = NULL,
    `correlated_genes` = NULL,
    `csv` = NULL,
    `dpi` = NULL,
    `exclude_low_depth` = NULL,
    `exclude_samples` = NULL,
    `figure` = NULL,
    `format` = NULL,
    `height_in` = NULL,
    `html` = NULL,
    `identifier_column` = NULL,
    `inline_image` = NULL,
    `keep_groups` = NULL,
    `log_transform` = NULL,
    `low_depth_fraction` = NULL,
    `normalization` = NULL,
    `outline_text` = NULL,
    `output_name` = NULL,
    `scale_genes` = NULL,
    `scree` = NULL,
    `show_caption_color_keys` = NULL,
    `show_figure_legends` = NULL,
    `show_row_counts` = NULL,
    `size` = NULL,
    `supplementary_file` = NULL,
    `survival_detail` = NULL,
    `survival_median_lines` = NULL,
    `top_genes` = NULL,
    `width_in` = NULL,
    progress_callback = NULL
)

Arguments

session

A GeneFox session from gf_session.

accession

(string) GEO series accession, e.g. GSE62564.

biplot

(boolean, optional; default false) Overlay the top 8 gene loading vectors on the figure (the screen's biplot; runs the correlated-genes solve). NULL omits it.

color_by

(string, optional) Color by exact geo_series_expression characteristics[].untrusted_key. Use at most one of color_by, color_gene and color_probe. NULL omits it.

color_gene

(string, optional) Color by this gene's expression (quantile bins), resolved as geo_series_expression resolves a gene (an ambiguous symbol lists its rows). NULL omits it.

color_probe

(string, optional) Color by this matrix row's expression (quantile bins). NULL omits it.

correlated_genes

(boolean, optional; default false) Also return correlated genes' PC1/PC2 correlations, loadings, cuts and captions, with optional PNG and section CSV. NULL omits it.

csv

(boolean, optional; default false) Also write the screen's CSV export (the app's own rows) under the output directory and return csv.path. NULL omits it.

dpi

(integer, optional; default 300; range 72..1200) Resolution of a custom size (at most 8,192 px a side and 16 MP). NULL omits it.

exclude_low_depth

(boolean, optional; default false) For integer counts, drop samples below low_depth_fraction of median library size before normalization; flagged in data.library_sizes and caption. NULL omits it.

exclude_samples

(array, optional) Exclude sample ids from data.points. Exclusions prevent a deep link because saved views do not record them. NULL omits it.

figure

(boolean, optional; default true) Draw the figure and return its PNG path. NULL omits it.

format

(string, optional; one of "png", "svg", "tiff"; default "png") Figure format: png (raster, default), svg (vector with editable text), or tiff (raster, .tif); one per run. NULL omits it.

height_in

(number, optional; range 1..40) Custom figure height in inches (with the other side; instead of size). The app's size control range. NULL omits it.

html

(boolean, optional; default false) Write the screen's single-figure HTML export under the output directory and return html.path. Requires figure. NULL omits it.

identifier_column

(string, optional) Key the matrix rows by this supplementary column instead of the inferred one: its exact header text, from geo_supplementary_layout's identifier_candidates. Integrity still applies: a column with repeated or empty values, a sample column, or a header the file lacks is refused (invalid_argument, field identifier_column), never replaced. Reads supplementary files only (the named file, else the ranked walk). Links and recipes record it. NULL omits it.

inline_image

(boolean, optional; default false) Include PNG MCP image content up to 1,048,576 bytes; larger files stay on disk and disclose inline_image_omitted. NULL omits it.

keep_groups

(array, optional) Show only these groups of color_by; the PCA is recomputed on the retained samples, copied exactly from a previous call's levels (the screen's group filter). Statistics (r, r², n, the group test and its df) are recomputed on the retained samples with the other levels dropped, as R's droplevels(subset(...)); a level not in the data is refused, never ignored. NULL omits it.

log_transform

(boolean, optional) Apply log2(x+1) before PCA. Default: the screen's (on for a linear-scale matrix without negative values). NULL omits it.

low_depth_fraction

(number, optional; default 0.1; range 0.001..0.999) Low-depth threshold as a fraction of the median library size (default 0.1). NULL omits it.

normalization

(string, optional; one of "none", "cpm", "log_cpm"; default "none") cpm or log_cpm require non-negative integer counts (edgeR::cpm, prior.count 2 for log_cpm; column-sum library sizes, no TMM). log_cpm is log2; leave log_transform off. NULL omits it.

outline_text

(boolean, optional; default false) With format svg, write labels as glyph outlines instead of editable text. Refused with other formats. NULL omits it.

output_name

(string, optional) Optional figure name replacing tool and title slug: up to 64 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'; starts alphanumeric, no '..'. Session number, size and extension remain; collisions get -2, -3, etc. NULL omits it.

scale_genes

(boolean, optional; default true) Scale each gene to unit variance (correlation PCA); the screen default. NULL omits it.

scree

(boolean, optional; default false) Also run the screen's scree solve and return its component rows, report caption and optional PNG/CSV export. NULL omits it.

show_caption_color_keys

(boolean, optional; default true) Figure style: a table caption carries the sentence explaining the figure's colors. NULL omits it.

show_figure_legends

(boolean, optional; default true) Figure style: the figure draws its own legend. NULL omits it.

show_row_counts

(boolean, optional; default true) Figure style: a box plot's row labels carry each group's n. NULL omits it.

size

(string, optional; one of "single_column", "one_and_a_half_column", "double_column", "slide", "poster"; default "double_column") Figure size preset (the app's export presets); double_column is the app default. NULL omits it.

supplementary_file

(string, optional) Exact decoded basename from geo_supplementary_layout; no path, URL, encoding or surrounding whitespace. Only this file is analyzed; no fallback, saved-view links or recipes. NULL omits it.

survival_detail

(string, optional; one of "none", "inference", "inferenceAndEffect", "full"; default "inferenceAndEffect") Figure style: how much of a Kaplan-Meier findings block to draw (the app's Figure Style setting). NULL omits it.

survival_median_lines

(boolean, optional; default false) Figure style: draw dashed median survival guides for reached medians. NULL omits it.

top_genes

(integer, optional; default 2000; range 2..100000) Most variable rows retained (screen: 2,000). Counts exceeding PCA workspace memory budget are refused (response_too_large). NULL omits it.

width_in

(number, optional; range 1..40) Custom figure width in inches (with the other side; instead of size). The app's size control range. NULL omits it.

progress_callback

Optional function receiving runtime progress events; NULL disables progress.

Value

A gf_result holding the engine payload, provenance and owned figures for the geo_sample_pca tool. The runtime validates every argument and refuses tools absent from its gf_tools() list. Result contract: https://genefox.app/schemas/v1/geo-sample-pca-result-v1.schema.json.

See also

gf_scientific_tools, gf_tools, gf_call
